mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST rises > 10% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment-population ratio (proxied by RSAFS) falls by more than 1pp from its 12-month high, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS falls > 1pp from 12-month high.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP growth accelerates and the unemployment rate falls, it signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.
